create_custom_hook: create a custom hook class that inherits from Hook and overrides before_train and after_train methods
override_before_run: override the before_run method in a Hook subclass to set up resources before training starts
check_every_n_epochs: use the every_n_epochs method to trigger an action every n epochs during training
check_end_of_epoch: use the end_of_epoch method to detect when the current batch is the last in the dataloader
get_triggered_stages: call get_triggered_stages on a Hook subclass instance to list all overridden lifecycle stages
